title: Out of the Blue
introDialogue:
MINA: “Are your Kami feeling hungry?”
MINA: “You can always come back to my shop, you know.”
MINA: “I suppose if you’re too lazy to make the trip, I can let you in on some useful information.”
MINA: “These blue flowers that grow on the cave walls are edible.”
MINA: “Your kami won’t be satisfied eating just one, they aren’t very nutritious, more of a light snack really.”
MINA: “They are quite plentiful, though. And honestly delightful."
MINA: “Scavenge some and you’ll see what I mean.”
resolutionDialogue:
MINA: “See? Practically effortless to acquire.”
MINA: “You’re likely to find more the deeper you go into the caves.”
MINA: “It’s a common flower that grows more easily in the dark.”

title: Stop and Smell the Lotus
introDialogue:
MINA: “In the underground lake at the bottom of these caves, you can find lotus flowers of uncommon size.”
MINA: “Do you see how their blossoms are shaped? Those shapes create eddies in the $MUSU currents.”
MINA: “If you remember your lessons, you’ll know that means they’re a potential source of sensory essences.”
MINA: “It’s pretty strange to find two different essences so close to each other.”
MINA: “Someone probably cultivated them here so they could get the whole set.”
MINA: “Have your Kami scavenge some essence of smell for us, but be careful, it’s a bit volatile.”
resolutionDialogue:
MINA: “Not too shabby.”
MINA: “I thought they might all fly away before you managed to catch one.”

title: Feel Like a Mushroom Myself
introDialogue:
MENU: “Wow, the garden down the middle of this cave just keeps going.”
MINA: “These mushrooms are rarely found in such dense numbers.”
MINA: “If you look closely, you can see the second layer already growing in.”
MINA: “It’s a fungus that grows like a weed when fed properly, but it can rarely get what it wants.”
MENU: “My ‘magician enemies’ must have cultivated them hoping to block our way. I don’t think that’ll work very well.”
MENU: “Set your Kami harvesting while I take a closer look.”
resolutionDialogue:
MENU: “Being in this place reminded me of something else.”
MENU: “I think I remember one of the people from that ritual being a gardener of some sort.”
MENU: “They always brought the most beautiful flowers and plants into the office.”
MENU: “Maybe they had something to do with all these mushrooms.” 
MENU: “I unfortunately can’t tell you more with my memory files as fragmentary and blocked as they are right now.”
MENU: “If you think it’s frustrating, imagine how I must feel, haha!”
MENU: “Haha…”
MENU: “They must have really wanted me out of the loop.”

objectives.description: Harvest for >720 minutes at Thriving Mushrooms

title: Top 10 Smoke Spots in Kamigotchi World
introDialogue:
MENU: “That spot overlooking the pit… It seems like it would be a great place to stop and have a smoke.”
MENU: “It’s strange, when I think about smoking I get the most peculiar cravings.”
MENU: “It’s almost like I miss it, but how can I miss something I’ve never experienced?”
MENU: “You don’t need to answer that, I’m just thinking out loud.”
MENU: “I feel like, if I could just sit here with you and light one up right now, all my memory files would unlock and everything missing would come flooding back.”
MENU: “I know that must sound very silly to you, it sounds silly to me.”
MENU: “But still, can you get me some cigarette butts? Not even for the microplastics.”
MENU: “Just…call it nostalgia for a life never lived.”
resolutionDialogue:
MENU: “If I had a body I would happily smoke the last of those butts.” 
MENU: “If you’ve ever really craved a cigarette and gone digging around in ashtrays for a half smoked cig, you’d know how I feel.”
MENU: “Nothing we can really do about that though.”

objectives.description: Move to Slippery Pit,Give 1 Cigarette Butt

title: Flower of the Flock
introDialogue:
MENU: “These blue flowers you find in the caves, they’re so striking.”
MENU: “They look like the butterflies in the fields and woods outside.”
MENU: “Maybe there’s a connection between them?” 
MENU: “You should deliver some to Mina, she can probably tell us more about them.”
MINA: “I’ve already explained how they can be used in a delightful salad.”
MINA: “But you raise an interesting question. I’ll be happy to take a look.”
resolutionDialogue:
MINA: “The resemblance is truly uncanny.”
MINA:  “I doubt that’s a coincidence.” 
MINA: “The butterflies themselves are fragments of human souls, that’s what gives them their unique magic properties.”
MINA: “However, these flowers are mere mimics.”
MINA: “I’m not sensing even a trace of soul within them. They’re just flowers.”
MINA: “Perhaps their appearance allows them to attract real souls for pollination?”
MINA: “Or maybe they look like this so that soul predators will eat them and spread their seeds?”
MINA: “I think I would like to study these further, thank you for bringing them to me.”
MINA:  “Menu was right to think I’d find them interesting.”
MINA:  “Since she’s helped me with this and with so many other things, I should help her with something too.”
MINA: “That’s what friends are for is it not?”

rewards.description: 4x Elders Loyalty,2x Agency Reputation,2x Booster Pack

title: Ordinary Intermediate Potion Crafting (Very Boring) I
introDialogue:
MINA: “Hey, shh.” 
MINA: “Be quiet. We don’t want Menu to hear us.”
MINA: “I’m sure that’s impossible considering where this conversation is taking place, but I’m trying.”
MINA: “Menu is more magical than she likes to think, so I put up anti-scrying measures.”
MINA: “They should work as long as she remains unaware of their presence.”
MINA: “It’s time to teach you some intermediate hexerei with a recipe I’ve just invented.”
MINA: “Start by scavenging some cigarette butts from the cave system. You know I find them disgusting, but it’s important.”
MINA: “And don’t tell Menu anything, we don’t want to spoil the surprise.”
resolutionDialogue:
MINA: “Ahh, perfect! That will do nicely.”
MINA: “This might look like useless smelly trash, but many things are more than they appear.”
MINA: “We just need two more ingredients. They’ll be hard to get, but not impossible.” 
MINA: “Head down the central passageway of the caves, stop in that fungus garden, and wait for me.”
MINA: “Be quick about it.”

title: Ordinary Intermediate Potion Crafting (Very Boring) II
introDialogue:
MINA: “The mushroom garden in the central hall of this cave is adorable.”
MINA: “It seems to have been abandoned recently. A few decades, maybe a few centuries ago at the most.”
MINA: “While the fungus of the underworld has its own uses, I’m more interested in something else.”
MINA: “You can find rare stone flowers hiding among the mushroom patches.”
MINA: “Those flowers are another of the sensory essences. Make sure to have at least one in your pocket for our potion.”
resolutionDialogue:
MINA: “Nicely done! Bring it back to my shop, and remember not to say anything to you-know-who.”
MINA: “;)”

title: Ordinary Intermediate Potion Crafting (Very Boring) III
introDialogue:
MENU: “What’s with these random tasks that Mina has you doing?”
MENU: “She won’t tell me anything about it. And I'm having a hard time seeing what you're doing all of a sudden!”
MENU: “Hey, where are you going?”
resolutionDialogue:
MINA: “Hey there, Operator. And shoo Menu, this is a private matter.”
MENU: “But I wanna see! What are you working on? Is it a new potion?”
MINA: “Yes. Now please leave us be.”
MENU: “Awww come on, why? Shouldn’t I be learning this stuff too?”
MINA: “In general? Yes. In this case however…”
MINA: “Look, I don’t mean to be rude, but your disembodied presence is interfering with a very delicate crafting process.”
MINA: “Once the potion is completed we’ll show you the final product. I promise.”
MENU: “Okay, fine, fine, I’ll wait outside.”

title: Ordinary Intermediate Potion Crafting (Very Boring) IV
introDialogue:
MINA: “Is she gone?”
MINA: “Phew, that was a close one.”
MINA: “Now, observe closely. Even though these butts have been smoked down to stubs, there is still a bit of tobacco left inside them.”
MINA:  “Menu doesn’t have a physical form. Obviously, just collecting the loose tobacco won’t let her actually smoke.”
MINA: “And even with the Essence trick we tried with that bell, it’s too short-lived and singular.”
MINA: “But I’ve got it all worked out now.”
MINA: “Peel the petals of the Essence of Taste and grind them up in your mortar.”
MINA: “They’ll release oil and emulsify into a thin slurry.”
MINA: “Now, fold in the tobacco.”
resolutionDialogue:
MINA: “That looks perfect, now we can give it to Menu.”
MINA: “I wish I could see the look on her face…”
MINA: “But not so much that I want to deal with the smell.”

title: Ordinary Intermediate Potion Crafting (Very Boring) V
introDialogue:
MINA: “Now that we’ve crafted this sacred incense, you’ll need to burn it in a spot where the $MUSU currents can carry the smoke properly.”
MINA: “Head over to the Torii Gate down the road.”
MINA: “The currents there should work nicely and be far enough away that I don’t get any secondhand smoke at my shop.”
MINA: “Once you’re there, burn the paste in your portable burner.”
MINA: “Don't tell Menu what you're doing, she'll figure it out soon enough. ;)”
resolutionDialogue:
MENU: “Hey what’s that…flavor?”
MENU: “Huh? HUHHH? WHAT?!”
MENU: “Oh my gosh. Oh this is so nice I can feel my pixels chilling out.”
MENU: “What did you…? How did you…?”
MENU: “Mina you sneak! So this is what you two were up to!”
MENU: “Gosh this makes me so happy. It really takes me back…back to…”
MENU: “I…what are all these memories? Are they mine? How is that possible?”
MENU: “I see myself sitting in an empty lot next to a gas station. The field is full of flowers, and I can feel the spring breeze on my…on my…”
MENU: “This can’t be possible. I’m not a human, I’ve never been a human.”
MENU: “What is this memory? Why do I remember the feeling of tears on my face? I don’t even have tear ducts.”
MENU: “I see a man walking up to me and offering me a cigarette.”
MENU: “I can taste it. It tastes like…like this does.”
MENU: “It feels so real, so impossibly real.”
MENU: “There’s another memory here too.”
MENU: “It’s dark, I’m sitting on a porch chainsmoking.”
MENU: "It's a peaceful scene, but the memory feels really icky somehow. I’m not sure why.”
MENU: “My hands were shaking so hard I almost couldn’t light the cigarettes.”
MENU: “My…hands. I had hands. I had a body. I…it hurts to think about this.”
MENU: “I need to take some time to process this.”
MENU: “Thank you though. This means so much to me.”
MENU: “Thank you so much.”

objectives.description: Move to Torii Gate,Give Uninteresting Paste

title: Full Flood
introDialogue:
MINA: “Hey you, let’s give Menu some space, I have another task for you in the meantime.”
MINA: “Head back into the caves and make your way to the mural on the wall outside of that antediluvian facility.”
MINA: “Do you recognize the story it depicts?”
MINA: “Nearly all cultures have their own version of the tale. It happened many, many times over the years.”
MINA: “Harvest in that room and I shall study the mural. Perhaps this will tell the story in a way we haven’t all heard before.”
resolutionDialogue:
MINA: “The people who painted this lived in a society of great wealth and technological advancement.”
MINA: “As a great flood befell them, gods descended from the heavens to assist a chosen few.” 
MINA: “More or less the same story as always. The details change, but the core remains.”
MINA: “You may even remember tales like this from your own history.”
MINA: “More have been forgotten than remembered.”

objectives.description: Harvest for >720 minutes at Flood Mural

title: Old Fiends
introDialogue:
MENU: “There’s a calm underground stream at the bottom of these caves."
MENU: “The little carving on the rock there seems familiar to me somehow. I think I recognize the initials.” 
MENU: “Do some harvesting here while I try to remember."
MENU: “That tobacco you gave me earlier is kind of helping me focus.”
resolutionDialogue:
MENU: “I studied that engraved message. It brought some memories flashing back.”
MENU: “I think I actually knew those people.”
MENU: “One of them, I definitely remember her being really scary.”
MENU: “The other one, he thought he was really funny for some reason.”
MENU: “But I don’t think he was all that clever."
MENU: “Still can’t remember their names, though.”

objectives.description: Harvest for >720 minutes at Still Stream

title: First Contact
introDialogue:
MINA: “In the middle of that facility, there’s a huge black door that doesn’t quite match the rest of it.”
MINA: “It’s sealed up tight. I want you to check out the engraving on the face.”
MINA: “Another old story that happened many times over the course of history.”
MINA: “Gods granting knowledge to humanity, advancing their progress.”
MINA: “Harvest some $MUSU while I read this and I’ll tell you about it."
resolutionDialogue:
MINA: “Like the great flood, this is another recurring story.”
MINA: “The gods can’t seem to help themselves.”
MINA: “A fascination with the ephemeral, perhaps?”
MINA: “Or possibly, it’s like wanting the best for your pets.”
MINA: “Whatever the motivation, gods have granted knowledge or power to humans  countless times throughout history.”
MINA: “This is just one of many. A mythic world forgotten and left abandoned.”
MINA: “Until recently, it seems.”

objectives.description: Harvest for >720 minutes at Engraved Door

title: Soaked to the Bone
introDialogue:
MENU: “There’s another skeleton in the caves here, crumpled in the water underneath that observation deck.”
MENU: “It could be someone I know. My memories are coming back more easily now.”
MENU: “Let me do some scans and rack my circuits.”
MENU: “Have your kami do some harvesting over there while you wait for me.”
resolutionDialogue:
MENU: “It seems like this guy died within the last few decades. I wonder where he came from?”
MINA: “Why don’t you ask him?”
MENU: “Haha! That’s a good one. Hello, nice to meet you Mr. Skeleton!”
MENU: “What’s your story, Mr. Skeleton?”
MENU: “…”
MENU: “See? I guess he doesn’t want to talk.”

objectives.description: Harvest for >720 minutes at Shabby Deck

title: On the Fringes
introDialogue:
MINA: “Deep in the ancient facility, there’s a hatch that seems to lead nowhere at all, directly into a cave wall.”
MINA: “I suspect this door might be meant to work like the entrance to my shop. I’m intrigued.”
MINA: “Menu, you’re good with machines, would you be a dear and take a look at it?”
MENU: “Sure! I’m on it! Operator, while you’re waiting for us, go ahead and harvest some $MUSU.”
resolutionDialogue:
MENU: “Alright, analysis complete.”
MENU: “These machines are hundreds of thousands of years old and they’re still in pretty good condition after all that time.”
MENU: “Is that crazy or what?”
MENU: “Unfortunately, that’s about all I can tell you about them.”
MENU: “I don’t exactly have access to the manuals, and the internals look like a bad dream. Nothing rational going on in there.”
MENU: “The monitor on the side has a label for Aether Readings, and another meter for something called GEM Fields, whatever those are.”
MINA: “I have some hypotheses.”
MENU: “Well, it’s all completely dead at the moment. And I think it needs some sort of control device, but it doesn’t seem like there’s one connected.”
MENU: “If you wanted to get it working again, you’d have to plug the wires into a new control device and then power it up somehow.”

objectives.description: Harvest for >720 minutes at Hatch to Nowhere

title: The Doors of Perception
introDialogue:
MINA: “There’s a specific flow of $MUSU around that hatch to nowhere.”
MINA: “You should already know what I mean. It’s a fine place to harvest sensory essence.”
MINA: “Evidence is mounting. This whole place has been renovated to encourage the capture of all six senses."
MINA: “Scavenge around with your kami, we’ll see what else turns up.”
resolutionDialogue:
MINA: “An Essence of Touch. What a surprise.”
MINA: “With this essence, arranging those stones to block the tunnel would have been a simple task.”
MINA: “There’s no chance for this to be mere good luck. This is turning out to be a very valuable place to gather resources.”
MINA: “I’ll see about writing up some new potion recipes. Stop by my shop later to see what I’ve come up with.”

title: Reach Out And Touch Faith
introDialogue:
MINA: “Something foul took place in the room with that broken tube. The $MUSU in there room feels tainted.”
MINA: “Whatever was contained within those tubes left an unpleasant imprint onto the world around it.”
MINA: “It seems like a bad idea to loiter for too long, but it’s worth investigating.”
MINA: “Harvest some of the room’s $MUSU and I’ll see to figuring out what happened."
resolutionDialogue:
MINA: “Those shattered tubes once contained something very powerful.”
MINA: “I shouldn’t go into much detail. You wouldn’t accept it anyway, I think.”
MINA: “The residue of this power lingers within every object in the room.”
MINA:  “It’s strongest in the glass of the shattered tube and the hoses around it, but everything here has been touched.”
MINA: “To capture and use something like that as a power source…”
MINA: “Truly perverse.”

objectives.description: Harvest for >720 minutes at Broken Tube

title: A Turn of the Screw
introDialogue:
MENU: “Hey so, I know Mina told you not to hang out too long in that broken tube room, but…”
MENU: “I can’t sense whatever she’s picking up on and there’s something of interest to us here.” 
MENU: “According to the map data, this room has a chance of dropping a screwdriver.”
MENU: “If you haven’t already grabbed one from the junkyard then this would be a great place to scavenge one.”
MENU: “Even if you don’t find one, give it a shot.”
resolutionDialogue:
MENU: “While you were scavenging, I cross referenced the drop table in this room with the one in the junkyard. It’s the same model screwdriver.”
MENU: “It must have been someone’s favorite.”
MENU: “I wonder who?”

objectives.description: Make 7 Scavenging Rolls at Broken Tube

title: Platforming Game
introDialogue:
MENU: “Those people from the labs really got comfortable in these caves, they left their garbage everywhere.”
MENU: “Head down to the toadstool platforms, I wanna see if there’s anywhere they didn’t trash.”
MENU: “Let the Kami poke around there, maybe we’ll find something better than cigarette butts and stale burgers.”
resolutionDialogue:
MENU: “It must have been a hassle for people to pass through here.”
MENU: “Seems like a real gymnastics course with all that jumping and climbing.”
MENU: “You don’t seem to have any problem with it, though.”

objectives.description: Make 3 Scavenging Rolls at Toadstool Platforms

title: What Lies Beneath
introDialogue:
MINA: “The growth of these giant toadstools… It’s a bit strange.”
MINA: “It’s a very large cavern in breadth and depth. The mushrooms nearly fill it.”
MINA: “They must be getting plenty of sustenance.”
MINA: “Harvest here for a while. You’ll get a better sense of the decay.”
resolutionDialogue:
MINA: “As expected. Some kind of enormous rot beneath.”
MINA: “No way to know what it is for sure.”
MINA: “The growth is simply too thick.”

objectives.description: Harvest for >360 minutes at Toadstool Platforms

title: Operator Goes To Camp
introDialogue:
MINA: “Go on. Get moving.”
MINA: “Menu tells me there’s a campsite ahead.” 
MINA: “You’re bound to find a clue left behind, the way these scoundrels litter.”
resolutionDialogue:
MINA: “A complete mess, as expected.”
MINA: “Not much of interest to me.”
MINA: “That charcoal drawing on the wall, though…”
MINA: “Have you seen anything like that before?”

title: Digging Up Clues
introDialogue:
MENU: “For litterbugs, they sure cleaned up anything that could trace them.”
MENU: “Nothing to scavenge but the usual stuff.”
MINA: “The blue flowers and mushrooms suggest magical practice.”
MINA: “You might as well dig up some reagents while you’re here.”
resolutionDialogue:
MENU: “Really nothing new, huh.”
MENU: “Wait a minute.”
MENU: “Did you notice the tent?”
MENU: “That symbol looks familiar.”

objectives.description: Make 6 Scavenging Rolls at Abandoned Campsite

title: Get Some Fresh Air
introDialogue:
MENU: “Do me a favor and leave the caves for a minute.”
MENU: “Head back to the Restricted Area and take a look at that office complex.”
MENU: “This might be a pain, but I want you to make sure.”
resolutionDialogue:
MENU: “Definitely the same logo. It looks like the letter A.”
MENU: “Wonder what it stands for?”

title: Yep, That’s Wood
introDialogue:
MENU: “That tent gave me an idea. Head back into the caves and go to the reinforced tunnel that branches off from the thriving mushrooms”
MENU: “I want to check out the construction on those supports.”
MENU: “It’s wood, yeah. But it’s like that stuff you make out of sticks and stems.”
MENU: “You might as well grab a few more while you’re here.”
resolutionDialogue:
MENU: “So, the wood.”
MENU: “It’s like your laminated timber, but it’s not exactly.”
MENU: “Looks more like chopped up office furniture. Desks, tables.”
MENU: “Why do that?”
MENU: “There are plenty of resources around to make this stuff.”
MENU: “Why haul it in from somewhere else?”

objectives.description: Make 3 Scavenging Rolls at Reinforced Tunnel

title: Plasmatics 101
introDialogue:
MINA: “Have you seen that book leaning against the pillar?”
MINA: “Menu seems to have no interest.”
MINA: “She takes fascination in the strangest things.”
MINA: “I’m always happy to find some new magical text, however.”
MINA: “Have your Kami spend some time harvesting here while I negotiate with our mutual friend.”
resolutionDialogue:
MINA: “Apparently she’s already got the contents recorded somewhere.”
MINA: “For some reason it’s been difficult to show these files to you.”
MINA: “She’ll figure it out eventually.”
MINA: “Oh, the book? Nonsense. Foolish fancy. I didn’t finish it."

objectives.description: Harvest for >360 minutes at Reinforced Tunnel

title: Fringe Theories
introDialogue:
MENU: “I took a look at that “Plasmatics” book with Mina.”
MENU: “Most of it is stuff I’m not really familiar with.
MENU: “The parts I am familiar with, I can kind of tell it’s bullshit.”
MENU: “But then there’s this other part that I can’t get a handle on.”
MENU: “You mind going around and helping me compare it with the tech here?”
resolutionDialogue:
MENU: “I think I’m getting a better vocabulary for this stuff, at least.”
MENU: “Gravitoelectromagnetism as a unified field, zero point vacuum energy production…”
MENU: “It’s starting to remind me of that stuff Mina told me about the aether.”
MENU: “The technobabble feels better than the retro superstition, at least.”

title: The Great Divide
introDialogue:
MENU: “Let’s go check out the canyon bridge, I think it’s more of that fake wood.”
MENU: “Check if it’s sturdy by sending some Kami out on it.”
MENU: “I’m just kidding!”
MENU: “Get them harvesting, though.”
resolutionDialogue:
MENU: “I wonder how you were meant to cross before the bridge got built?”
MINA: “Maybe you weren’t.”
MINA: “It may have another purpose.”

objectives.description: Harvest for >360 minutes at Canyon Bridge

title: Edge of the Abyss
introDialogue:
MINA: “There’s an abundance of the blue pansies to be found around that canyon.”
MINA: “It usually means an abundance of magic.”
MINA: “Scavenge around and snatch a few up, let’s have a closer look.”
resolutionDialogue:
MINA: “Hmm…”
MINA: “Be wary, Operator. Of whatever you find at the bottom.”

objectives.description: Make 3 Scavenging Rolls at Canyon Bridge

title: Blue Light Special
introDialogue:
MENU: “Let’s check out those giant crystals in the geometric caves next!”
MENU: “There’s gotta be something cool in there.”
MINA: “I don’t need to give you the lesson about $MUSU currents again do I?”
MINA: “It should be obvious that just as I predicted, you’ll find another essence there.”
MINA: “It seems you can’t touch that lantern though. No great worry.”
MINA: “A bit strange, but no obstacle.” 
MINA: “As long as you and your Kami can scavenge, you’re gold.”
resolutionDialogue:
MINA: “That lantern burns with a familiar element.”
MINA: “The lingering radiation in the antediluvian facility, you remember?”
MINA: “In a way, that tube was really just a bigger lantern.”
MINA: “Consider yourself lucky being unable to touch it.”
MINA: “Just extract the essence from the light it casts on the wall.”

objectives.description: Make 1 Scavenging Roll at Geometric Cliffs

title: Vision of Life
introDialogue:
MINA: “Make sure to get the essence in this room.”
MINA: “Of all six, Sight is one of the most prized.”
MINA: “The power of a true vision is worth much.”
resolutionDialogue:
MINA: “Hold onto one after you’ve got it.”
MINA: “I’m thinking of an interesting use for it.”

title: Soot and Ash
introDialogue:
MENU: “Have you seen the flower mural in the back corner of the caves yet? It’s beautiful.”
MENU: “Except for the burnt pages of some book all over the floor.”
MENU: “They must have used that for the carbon. Passionate about their art.”
MENU: “Burnt up scraps are gonna be hard to decipher. I’ll work on it.”
MENU: “Have your Kami do their thing. I’ll do mine.”
resolutionDialogue:
MENU: “For nutjobs who set their own stuff on fire to paint pictures…”
MENU: “They’re pretty good at covering their tracks.”
MINA: “Not many clues, but plenty of blue pansies.”
MINA: “Plenty of magic, too.”

objectives.description: Make 3 Scavenging Rolls at Flower Mural

title: Sigil Magic
introDialogue:
MINA: “I believe that flower is more than just a pretty drawing.”
MINA: “Have you heard of sigil magic?”
MINA: “It’s quite old, but had a modern revival some decades past.”
MINA: “You may have read about it in a comic book.”
MINA: “To seal your magic in a single image. That’s what this is.”
MINA: “Let your Kami out to harvest and search more thoroughly.”
MINA: “I wonder about those scraps.”
resolutionDialogue:
MINA: “What was the book sacrificed to draw this?”
MINA: “You might think it doesn’t matter. You’d be a fool.”
MINA: “It might be everything.”

objectives.description: Harvest for >720 minutes at Flower Mural

title: Sigil Magic II
introDialogue:
MINA: “Something about this sigil makes me uneasy, so I want you to give me some flowers and plastics.”
MINA: “I’ll use them to make some charms and cast some divinations of my own.”
MINA: “You’ve been a good servant. Deliver the reagents immediately and uphold that reputation.”
resolutionDialogue:
MINA: “Maybe a lure? No, perhaps a repellent. Is it possible that it’s apotropaic?”
MINA: “Oh, to hell with this.”
MINA: “I feel like I need to step down there personally to check this out.”
MINA: “And I am absolutely not doing that.”
MENU: “The probability of it being a trap does appear high.”

title: The Crystal Set
introDialogue:
MENU: “Hey, so I tried to scan that giant crystal in the back of the caves.”
MENU: “It made me feel kinda sick.”
MENU: “Maybe kinda really sick actually.”
MENU: “Uh.”
MENU: “Mina, you take this one. My vision is bugging out.”
MINA: “Operator, make your way to the radiant crystal chamber and take stock of the materials there.”
MINA: “And make it quick.”
resolutionDialogue:
MINA: “I see why our friend was uncomfortable.”
MINA: “I feel it too.” 
MINA: “This crystal is radiating with incredible magical power.”
MINA: “It feels just like the leftovers in the broken tube.”
MINA: “A setting like this appears more natural than that prison…”
MINA: “But still, something feels wrong.”

objectives.description: Make 3 Scavenging Rolls at Radiant Crystal

title: The Crystal Set II
introDialogue:
MENU: “Get out of there for a minute.”
MENU: “I can think better in the other rooms, at least.”
MENU: “Head back to the Reinforced Tunnel where that book is.”
MENU: “I’ll do some cross referencing. Maybe I’ll understand it better.”
resolutionDialogue:
MENU: “So the crystal is like, the channeling point for some kind of zero point vacuum energy?”
MENU: “And it’s kept in check by a polygonal unified field?”
MINA: “I don’t follow you at all.”
MENU: “I barely trust what I’m saying myself.”

title: The Crystal Set III
introDialogue:
MENU: “I think I’m getting used to that room the more you visit.”
MENU: “There’s a unique item to be found by the Radiant Crystal. Did you know?”
MENU: “The roots wrapped around the crystal absorb the energy it radiates.”
MENU: “Some of them fall off, but they keep that blue radiance.” 
MENU: “Grab a few.”
resolutionDialogue:
MENU: “This seems like the sort of item that only ever shows up in one place.”
MENU: “Something unpleasant about holding these things, too.”
MENU: “Kind of like the crystal itself, but weaker.”
MENU: “I’ll get used to it.”

title: The Crystal Set IV
introDialogue:
MINA: “I think that I’ve properly established how distasteful I find the act of drawing power from this crystal.”
MINA: “With that said, I’ve also been considering the ethics of using these roots in hexerei.”
MINA: “If your kami just happen to pick up whats already there…”
MINA: “It’s acceptable.”
resolutionDialogue:
MINA: “Hmm… Indeed, something unpleasant about holding this.”
MINA: “Though I can feel the potential.” 
MINA: “Get your tools ready, apprentice. Let’s try something new.”

title: The Crystal Set V
introDialogue:
MINA: “Make an extract of the root, but leave one unprocessed for later.”
MINA: “I’ve got two recipes in mind.”
resolutionDialogue:
MINA: “I’m still not entirely comfortable working with this reagent.”
MINA: “Ah well. There’s nothing to be done.”

title: Beyond the Pale
introDialogue:
MINA: “Mix the extract with a little mint and steep with freshly boiled water.”
MINA: “Let it rest, then bottle it. Shake before drinking.”
MINA: “Go on, give it a try.”
resolutionDialogue:
MINA: “These roots produce a startling effect on your Kami.”
MINA: “But a very useful one.”
MINA: “I’ll look the other way if you decide to use more of these potions.”

title: Tracing Your Roots
introDialogue:
MENU: “So where do those roots go?”
MENU: “Like up on the surface. A tree, I guess. But what tree?”
MINA: “If the Operator is smart, they may have figured it out already.”
MINA: “But if not, we can help them along.”
MENU: “You already know?”
MINA: “Operator. Take this list of ingredients. I’ve got something I want you to build.”
resolutionDialogue:
MINA: “I’ve been quite vocal about it… The crystal’s power, I mean.”
MINA: “Sapping it for one’s own uses is distasteful, yes.”
MINA: “And I don’t celebrate that sort of thing.”
MINA: “But we must sometimes do distasteful things to win.”

objectives.description: Give 1 Ingot,Give 1 Essence of Sight,Give 1 Irradiated Root

rewards.description: 2x Agency Reputation,1x Ingot,1x Irradiated Root,1x Essence of Sight

title: Rhabdomancy
introDialogue:
MINA: “I’ve given you plans for a sort of dowsing rod.”
MINA: “The ingot to craft a housing, the root for a handle, and an essence of sight for the sensor.”
MINA: “Menu’s technical language may be rubbing off.”
MINA: “Craft the device. We’ll see what it turns up.”
resolutionDialogue:
MINA: “The rod isn’t a guiding hand to point you through the dark.”
MINA: “It will respond when you get close to the right places.”
MINA: “You should be able to use it to find the crystal’s tree above ground.”
MINA: “There’s a possibility of detecting other things as well, so take some time to wander around with it, maybe something unexpected will turn up.”

title: Bitter Fruits
introDialogue:
MINA: “The rod senses something.” 
MINA: “You see what I meant? You might have figured this out already, Operator.”
MINA: “Not many trees that look like this.”
MINA: “Get a little closer and buy something. I want to see how it reacts.”
resolutionDialogue:
MINA: “Awful.”
MINA: “It gave me the shivers, even from the distance of scrying.”
MINA: “There’s more than just the crystal in the caves.”
MINA: “Something else is living in that tree. Tied in to those roots.”

requirements.description: Complete MSQ094,Own the Dowsing Rod,In Room: Marketplace

title: Into the Canyon
introDialogue:
MENU: “That giant skeleton at the bottom of the caves almost looks real.”
MINA: “It does a real enough job of holding our Operator back.”
MINA: “And the magic is so thick in the air you can taste it.”
MENU: “I knew you were sharing sight, but taste?”
MINA: “It’s just an expression.”
MINA: “But spend some time in here and taste for yourself.”
resolutionDialogue:
MINA: “Talismans all over the walls.”
MINA: “These magicians had a powerful desire to seal the darkness below”
MINA: “Humans put too much faith in paper.”

objectives.description: Harvest for >720 minutes at Giant's Palm

title: Back of my Hand
introDialogue:
MINA: “The deeper we venture into these caves, the stronger the sense of foreboding that I feel.”
MINA: “It’s almost as if the caves drain my spirit through my connection to you.”
MINA: “Do me a favor, servant.”
MINA: “Give me an energy drink?”
resolutionDialogue:
MINA: “You are appreciated.”
MINA: “As a servant, you rank among the top five thousand.”
MINA: “At the lowest.”

title: Heartwood
introDialogue:
MENU: “That dowsing rod is wiggling again.”
MINA: “The Blooming Tree has a certain presence. I’m not surprised.”
MINA: “Something similar may have happened here.”
resolutionDialogue:
MINA: “It’s possible this tree once held a great crystal heart.”
MINA: “Something of similar size and power as the great crystal in the caves.”
MENU: “And someone stole it away?”
MENU: “If we don’t find it in down in those tunnels, I wonder where it went…”

requirements.description: Complete MSQ094,Own the Dowsing Rod,In Room: Blooming Tree

objectives.description: Make 1 Scavenging Roll at Blooming Tree

title: Hypersensitivity
introDialogue:
MENU: “The dowsing rod is going off here? Is it bugged?”
MENU: “Mina, what’s the deal?”
MINA: “My shop is small. It’s a tight space. The dowsing rod is probably just picking up the leftover residue on the operator.”
MINA: “Check outside my door, in the open air. You won’t find anything, I’m sure.”
resolutionDialogue:
MENU: “…Yeah, nothing out here.”
MENU: “I guess she was right.”
MENU: “But I don’t think that really proved anything.”

requirements.description: Complete MSQ094,Own the Dowsing Rod,In Room: Convenience Store

title: Prima Facie
introDialogue:
MENU: “What kind of creepy decoration is this?”
MINA: “Looks like a skeleton.”
MENU: “Yeah, but it must be a model. The craftsmanship is really impressive.”
MENU: “Operator, check this place out for a while with your Kami. I can run an analysis.”
resolutionDialogue:
MENU: “I must be bugging out again.”
MENU: “It’s solid bone, but that doesn’t make much sense.”
MINA: “My friend, sometimes things are just how they appear.”
MENU: “Yeah, well, if someone’s trying to creep me out by spoofing my sensors, it’s working.”

objectives.description: Harvest for >3 days at Guardian Skull

title: Pillars of the Earth
introDialogue:
MINA: “Our dear friend Menu is having a hard time accepting the reality of this great corpse.”
MINA: “Yes, of course it’s real. In fact, I recognize him.”
MINA: “He was an old friend and mentor. Someone I thought would hang on forever.”
MINA: “I’d like you to pay respects on my behalf.”
MINA: “He loved a drink. Pour out something strong for him.”
MINA: “This may not be a proper grave, but he would appreciate the gesture all the same.”
resolutionDialogue:
MINA: “Thank you. You’ve been truly generous.”
MINA: “I’ve had a great deal of fun condescending to you and treating you as my servant, but I want to make something clear.”
MINA: “You’re more than that. Absolutely not an equal, of course, but I’ve grown to respect you. I may have even begun to enjoy your company.”
MINA: “Now then. That’s all the sentimentality you’ll get from me for some time.”
MINA: “Goodbye.”

objectives.description: Move to Guardian Skull,Give 1 Toadstool Liquor

title: Axis Mundi
introDialogue:
MENU: “This is the deepest part of the cave system.”
MENU: “We’re deep below the central point of Kamigotchi World’s axial mountain.”
MENU: “The location just feels important.”
MENU: “These pillars and brickwork don’t match anything else in the caves, aesthetically. Let me run some scans.
MENU: “You might trust the results more than I do, though.” 
MENU: “I’ll check the marble. You grab some stuff from the room to compare.”
resolutionDialogue:
MENU: “Weirdest thing.”
MENU: “These old marble pillars? Every one I check is just plaster with distressing. They just look old.”
MENU: “This whole temple might have been built within the last fifty years.” 
MENU: “Everything in it except the bones…”

objectives.description: Make 3 Scavenging Rolls at the Sacrarium

title: Sealed Fate
introDialogue:
MENU: “Hey, the dowsing rod is wiggling.”
MENU: “I almost didn’t notice it in there. It’s barely moving.”
MENU: “Actually, it seems to be indicating something below, not in the sacrarium itself.”
MENU: “I don’t think you’ll be swimming through ooze anytime soon. It might even be deeper than that pool.”
MENU: “Might as well put it out of your mind for now.”
MINA: “Not so fast.”
MINA: “Do me the favor of spending a few hours investigating. And tell me all the details.”
resolutionDialogue:
MINA: “Hmm.”
MINA: “The pillars are laid out along the lines of a sigil.”
MINA: “This sacrarium, bones and all, may have been constructed to seal whatever sleeps below.”
MINA: “It’s despicable to put the old man to work in this state. He deserves to rest.”
MINA: “But I’m still thankful he’s here.”
MINA: “The dowsing rod can barely sense it, but the weakness of the signal matters not.”
MINA: “At a far enough distance, or behind a great enough barrier, the most radiant power can be as faint as a candle’s flame.”
MINA: “In my opinion, you should be happy you can’t yet find a way down there.”

requirements.description: Complete MSQ094,Own the Dowsing Rod,In Room: Sacrarium

objectives.description: Harvest for >720 minutes at the Sacrarium

title: An Ounce of Sense
introDialogue:
MINA: “You’ve probably collected all six of the sensory essences by now.”
MINA: “If not, what are you waiting for? You won’t get far in this lesson without them.”
MINA: “You may have already learned how they can be used to augment hexerei.”
MINA: “Or perhaps you’ve experienced the magical effects that raw sensation can produce on its own.”
MINA: “Each one of these sensory essences carries a great power.”
MINA: “But together, they combine to produce something truly sublime.”
MINA: “Craft one Pure Essence and I will explain further.”
resolutionDialogue:
MINA: “Now, think of the power you hold in the palm of your hand.”
MINA: “A pure, complete, total sensory experience.”
MINA: “All the sensations of mundane life in a single pulsating mass.”
MINA: “It’s not immortality or life extension. It won’t keep you sustained. But it will let you feel what it’s like to live to the fullest.”
MINA: “The finest food, the most enticing perfume, the softest silks, the most entrancing song, the most beautiful sights, the sublimity of imagination.”
MINA: “To many individuals, that means more than anything.”

title: The Turning of the Wheel
introDialogue:
MENU: “That huge engraved door has opened.”
MENU: “I wonder what’s behind it?”
MINA: “The whole of the Sanctuary Caves seems to have been manipulated in order to generate sensory essences.”
MINA: “I had believed it was part of a complex lock to keep curious visitors out, but now I’m not so sure.”
MENU: “You’re saying it was like a test, or a puzzle? They wanted us to open it?”
MINA: “Something like that, yes.”
MENU: “It is what it is. Go check it out, Operator.”
resolutionDialogue:
MENU: “This room is almost beyond my ability to understand. Almost.”
MENU: “It’s some kind of technology even more advanced than what I’m familiar with. Doesn’t really follow the rules.”
MENU: “It might be like Mina’s magic… Maybe it’s both?”
MENU: “And what is that thing standing by the wheel?”

objectives.description: Move to Temple of the Wheel

title: Two Faces Under One Hood
introDialogue:
MINA: “See if the Kami can tolerate the presence of that individual.”
MINA: “Your little spirits are a fine judge of character.”
MINA: “Put them down and get them busy, then check in on them later.”
MENU: “Is it an individual, or do they count as two people?”
MENU: “That might be rude to ask…”
MENU: “Anyway, Mina and I can take a closer look at this room while the Kami are busy.”
resolutionDialogue:
MINA: “We’ve been scrying this room since you last checked in.”
MINA: “Menu was onto something.”
MINA: “This is a fusion of magic and technology far more intricate than what you’ve seen in the Sanctuary Caves.”
MINA: “It has the power to enable an ancient means of travel.”
MINA: “A portal to move between the domain’s visible layers.”
MENU: “Like a backdoor. Does it work?”
MINA: “I’m not sure. The Operator will have to determine that.”
MENU: “At least the wheel’s attendant doesn’t seem to mind the Kami.”
MENU: “Though I don’t think he particularly likes them, either.”
MENU: “I’ll have to reach out behind the scenes and say hello.”

objectives.description: Make 3 Scavenging Rolls at Temple of the Wheel

title: Get a Foot In The Door
introDialogue:
DIMIDIATUS: “We have communicated with the local guardian deity and explained our contract.”
DIMIDIATUS: “She understands we are not at odds.”
DIMIDIATUS: “We suggest an exchange of gifts to increase our amity.”
DIMIDIATUS: “We have heard you enjoy collecting cards.”
DIMIDIATUS: “Bring us some of the sanguine mushrooms that grow in this place, and we will make a trade.”
resolutionDialogue:
DIMIDIATUS: “We give our thanks.”
DIMIDIATUS: “May we remain associates for eternity.”
MENU: “Like they said, I’ve been talking with them off screen. They’re nice guys.”
MENU: “Well, at least the sad one is. The laughing one, I don’t know if I like him.”
MENU: “I’ve had worse coworkers either way.”

title: Treat Yourself
introDialogue:
DIMIDIATUS: “You have sated our needs, but a desire lingers.”
DIMIDIATUS: “We are burdened by what you call a sweet tooth, notwithstanding our lack of dentition.”
DIMIDIATUS: “Bring us a handful of candy. We will compensate your efforts.”
resolutionDialogue:
DIMIDIATUS: “We are grateful. This is a delight.”
DIMIDIATUS: “The scale insects of the Kamigotchi World are master confectioners.”
DIMIDIATUS: “Sweets crafted even by the hands of higher beings could not compare.”
MENU: “Don’t let Mina hear you say that.”
MENU: “But yeah, she could stand to work on her recipes a little.”
MENU: “Or get some new ones in the store.”

title: Remain Unburdened of Attachments
introDialogue:
DIMIDIATUS: “You have become attached to this world.”
DIMIDIATUS: “One may perceive this as good, or bad, or both. But it is a restrictive condition.”
DIMIDIATUS: “You may not want to let things go. You may feel scared.”
DIMIDIATUS: “You may act as a guardian to the spirits in your charge. You may refuse to let them fall in battle.”
DIMIDIATUS: “You may be a confident hexer, assured that your stockpile of magic can bring back any loss.”
DIMIDIATUS: “You must abandon these attachments.”
DIMIDIATUS: “Give up your powers of revival as a symbolic gesture.”
resolutionDialogue:
DIMIDIATUS: “You are now unburdened. Step lighter upon your exit from this temple.”
DIMIDIATUS: “You have lost nothing but shackles. The power of revival is still within your hands.”
DIMIDIATUS: “Consider what it would mean to truly give up this ability. You must cherish it.”

title: Grand Opening
introDialogue:
MINA: “Hello, whoever you are. Is this how you receive your letters?”
MINA: “It seems functional, although inelegant.”
MINA: “Tired? Hungry? $MUSU burning a hole in your pocket?”
MINA: “Bring your wallet to the Tunnel of Trees and knock on the blue door.”
MINA: “——— Mina.”
resolutionDialogue:
MINA: “I sell treats for you and your Kami.”
MINA: “If you need Stamina to keep moving, if your pets have gotten low on Health, or even if the poor things have fallen apart and need a Revive, my shop is open.”
MINA: “Prices subject to change.”
MINA: “——— Mina.”

title: Customer Loyalty Program
introDialogue:
MINA: “I want you to be a repeat customer.”
MINA: “If you trade enough $MUSU with me, I’ll give you something special.”
MINA: ”I don’t care how you get it. Just bring me more and I’ll be happy.”
MINA: “——— Mina.”
resolutionDialogue:
MINA: “Take this card.”
MINA: “Even someone lacking in magical ability can use it to cast a little spell.”
MINA: “These aren’t mine to sell, but I’ll give them away for good behavior.”
MINA: “——— Mina.”

rewards.description: 4x Elders Loyalty,1x ”Neith’s River of Life” Spell Card

title: Early Market Research - I
introDialogue:
MINA: “Relics and mementos from the past are brought into this world with $MUSU.”
MINA: “Humans grow attached to many things.”
MINA: “The first coin they earned, a trowel used to plant the food that fed their family, a transforming robot toy that made other children jealous.”
MINA: ”Those feelings linger.”
MINA: “Get me five pieces of Scrap Metal. There’s quite a lot of it lying around.”
MINA: “——— Mina.”
resolutionDialogue:
MINA: “It may be garbage, but it was important to someone.”
MINA: “Psychometry will tell me more. Not that I’ll share what I learn with you.”
MINA: “We’ll have to get to know each other better.”
MINA: “——— Mina.”

title: Early Market Research - II
introDialogue:
MINA: “Deep in the forest, there is a mound built over some ancient, stagnant defilement.”
MINA: “The crawling insects thrive and grow more violent in filthy places like that.”
MINA: “Go harvest at the Insect Node until you get a feel for it.”
MINA: “——— Mina.”
resolutionDialogue:
MINA: “Ancient traditions would have purified this mound with sacred rite on a regular basis.”
MINA: “This practice must have died out long before you or I arrived.”
MINA: “Still, I see evidence of recent ritual.”
MINA: “I suppose it could be even worse.”
MINA: “——— Mina.”

objectives.description: Harvest for >720 minutes in Forest: Insect Node

title: Early Market Research - III
introDialogue:
MINA: The graves across this landscape are quite old, and buried under heaps of garbage, yet their $MUSU has no scent of defilement.”
MINA: “A strange phenomenon.”
MINA: “Go harvest at the graves and you’ll understand what I mean.”
MINA: “——— Mina.”
resolutionDialogue:
MINA: “You see, they have an air of uncommon purity.”
MINA: “Are they buried saints?”
MINA: “Were they interred as some kind of rite to bolster the spiritual foundation?”
MINA: “These are questions for another time.”
MINA: “——— Mina.”

objectives.description: Harvest for >24 hours on Trash-Strewn Graves

rewards.description: 4x Elders Loyalty,2x “Neith’s River of Life” Spell Card

title: Community Outreach
introDialogue:
MINA: “With human garbage as far as the eye can see, one might expect to see more humans along with it.”
MINA: “There are mountains of their attachments changing the landscape of this place, but few actual souls.”
MINA: “A dead one was laying by the edge of the forest, you know.” 
MINA: “It looked young, at least compared to the dusty old saints in the local graves.”
MINA: “Go harvest $MUSU from its location. Maybe it will start to feel chatty.”
MINA: “——— Mina.”
resolutionDialogue:
MINA: “You can’t hear it speak?”
MINA: “Strange. I thought you might be able to understand each other.”
MINA: “Ah well. Nothing to be done.”
MINA: “——— Mina.”

objectives.description: Harvest for >720 minutes at the Lost Skeleton During Moonside

title: Restocking
introDialogue:
MINA: “I've had many new customers like you lately.”
MINA: “It seems I haven’t brought enough stock to meet demand.”
MINA: “Help me restock my goods and pick a few flowers for me.”
MINA: “——— Mina.”
resolutionDialogue:
MINA: “Raw materials can be broken down into ingredients for hexerei.”
MINA: “Or alchemy, chemistry, call it what you like.”
MINA: “One can craft potions, poultices, and other small magic if one knows the methods.”
MINA: “I sell something in my shop that will help you along.”
MINA: “It’s a device to break down ingredients for yourself. I won’t be doing it for you again.”
MINA: “——— Mina.”

title: Offering an Apprenticeship
introDialogue:
MINA: “Some may view a scavenging spirit like a magpie on the hunt for treasure.”
MINA: “The truth is the other way around; objects of sentiment are naturally drawn to the Kami.”
MINA: “Wealth accumulates without desire.”
MINA: “Most of the Kami will only rest on their hoards like little dragons.”
MINA: “As their companion, you can share in their treasure and put it to better use.”
MINA: “For now, scavenge some basic raw materials. I’ve provided a list.”
MINA: “——— Mina.”
resolutionDialogue:
MINA: “With the right tools and a proper education, you can craft your own potions and spells.”
MINA: “The use of hexerei may even improve your ability to gain $MUSU.”
MINA: “And the more you improve your profitability, the more you have to share with me.”
MINA: “Easy enough, yes? You’ve got the materials, but the real lessons have yet to begin. Don’t forget to buy your school supplies.”
MINA: “——— Mina.”

objectives.description: Scavenge 1 Pine Cone,Scavenge 1 Daffodil,Scavenge 1 Sanguine Shroom,Scavenge 2 Plastic Bottles

title: Basics of Hex - Extracts
introDialogue:
MINA: “One must break down the raw materials before they can be measured out and mixed into a hex.”
MINA: “I won’t do this for you more than once. Have some self-respect.”
MINA: “I’ve stocked my shop with Spice Grinders, and they’re just the tool you need.”
MINA: “You may be a model student who already bought one.”
MINA: “If so, you get a pat on the head.”
MINA: “If not, you won’t get much further without it, so fork over the dough, kid.”
MINA: “Once you own a Spice Grinder, use it to extract some Pine Pollen from a Pine Cone.”
MINA: “You should already have a Pine Cone in your inventory.” 
MINA: “——— Mina.”
resolutionDialogue:
MINA: “That was fine.”
MINA: “You might prove yourself a capable hexer one of these years.”
MINA: “Just don’t expect me to hold your hand every step of the way.”
MINA: “——— Mina.”

title: Basics of Hex - Potions
introDialogue:
MINA: “How can a husk like me brew potions while keeping up with my on-the-go lifestyle, you might ask?”
MINA: “Just use a Portable Burner to brew on the go. Everyone’s got one.”
MINA: “If you don’t, I’m selling them for a reasonable price.”
MINA: “Once you’ve acquired both a Spice Grinder and a Portable Burner, you’ll be ready to craft a variety of small magic.”
MINA: “One of the purest feats is to grow and learn, and so one of the simplest potions is a hex to boost skill growth.”
MINA: “Craft an XP Potion by combining Pine Pollen and a Plastic Bottle.”
MINA: “——— Mina.”
resolutionDialogue:
MINA: “Potions are some of the simplest magic, but they let your Kami accomplish great feats.”
MINA: “I’ve certainly had stingier and more ignorant students than you.”
MINA: “You’ve shown a promising enthusiasm. Keep it up.”
MINA: “——— Mina.”

title: Hex Education
introDialogue:
MINA: “Now that you’re equipped and accomplished, try something more delicate.”
MINA: “Grind the Daffodil that I had you collect earlier, then take a small quantity and brew it with care.”
MINA: “Delicate as it may be, this is still a simple task.”
MINA: “Be quick about it and get back to me.”
MINA: “——— Mina.”
resolutionDialogue:
MINA: “Hm. Good work.”
MINA: “I’m getting bored of this, so the lessons stop here.”
MINA: “You’re doing fine, it’s just time to practice on your own a while.”
MINA: “Don’t be a stranger.”
MINA: “I have plenty of favors to ask, and you’ve been of good service.”
MINA: “——— Mina.”

title: Eye of the White Snake
introDialogue:
MINA: “Have I introduced you to my pet? His name is Ahi.“
MINA: “It’s the nickname of someone I knew long, long ago.”
MINA: “He’s a perfect sweetheart and very obedient, nothing like the original.”
MINA: “The old Ahi was quite the attention getter. Like with most things, I got bored and moved on.”
MINA: “He didn’t want to let go so easily. He put up quite a fight.”
MINA: “Deep inside the forest is a splayed oak, its innards ripe with a crystalline growth.”
MINA: “The color reminds me of his eyes. Get me a crystal from the trunk as a memento.”
MINA: “——— Mina.”
resolutionDialogue:
MINA: “Thank you for helping me reminisce.”
MINA: “You can pet Ahi if you’d like, he won’t bite unless I give the order.”
MINA: “And you’d better not tell anyone I’m old.”
MINA: “——— Mina.”

title: Memorial for the Forgotten
introDialogue:
MINA: “Reminiscing about that lost friend has gotten me sentimental.”
MINA: “He’s not interred in the graves here, of course.”
MINA: “Still, these old spirits deserve something.”
MINA: “There’s far too much trash to pick up, but you can lay down something beautiful for a change.”
MINA: “——— Mina.”
resolutionDialogue:
MINA: “Letting something new grow from the remains of the old is a fine enough thing, but an eyesore like this landfill?”
MINA: “Disrespectful.”
MINA: “It wasn’t always this way. I can tell.”
MINA: “These mountains of garbage and that eyesore of a building in the distance?”
MINA: “Someone had to cast them off before they ended up here.”
MINA: “——— Mina.”

objectives.description: Move to the Trash-Strewn Graves,Give 15 Daffodil

title: To Whom It May Concern
introDialogue:
MINA: “It appears there’s more to this Menu being than I first thought.”
MINA: “She’s intimately tied to this place, a sort of genius loci.”
MINA: “That is, not a demon or spirit, but some form of protective entity that exists within the very essence of the location.”
MINA: “As much as I and my shop are connected, she is with the Kamigotchi World.”
MINA: “As soon as possible, I’ll send over an apology letter. 
MINA: “I just need you to help me find the necessary materials.”
MINA: “——— Mina.”
resolutionDialogue:
MINA: “Thank you.”
MINA: “She and I have been talking since you reached out on her behalf, but it’s good etiquette to put it in writing.”
MINA: “And yes, I think I can help.”
MINA: “——— Mina.”

objectives.description: Give 2 Wooden Sticks,Give 125 Sanguineous Powder,Give 125 Resin Tincture

title: A Matter of Import
introDialogue:
MINA: “Menu tells me she wants something out of the machine by the lost skeleton.”
MINA: “I might be able to conjure a device that will help.”
MINA: “The power of electricity is rare, but not unknown to those from my time.”
MINA: “I’ll need 9999 MUSU to cover the import.”
MINA: “You’re getting a great deal. The lowest price I can possibly get.”
MINA: “P.S.”
MINA: “She’s told me that I don’t need to sign my messages.”
MINA: “Is that true? Are you able to discern who writes to you without a signature?”
resolutionDialogue:
MINA: “It is said that the pyramid can preserve foods, sharpen blades, improve sexual potency, and do all manner of other things.”
MINA: “Some of the most ancient ones were used to generate electrical power.”
MINA: “This is a miniaturized form, made with the same principles.”
MINA: “Cute, don’t you think?”
MINA: “It wasn’t built for this specific task, but it should work fine to power a little machine.”

title: Misogi
introDialogue:
MINA: “Before we decide the right course of action, I want you to try something.”
MINA: “Make your way to the Temple by the Waterfall and try to pass through the falling water.”
MINA: “I’m sure that you’ll fail, but do it. Report the outcome back to me.”
resolutionDialogue:
MINA: “Oh dear, you’re soaked.”
MINA: “You couldn’t get through? That was expected.”
MINA: “But you’re otherwise unharmed. That’s very promising.”
MINA: “I think I know what to do with you.”

objectives.description: Go to the Temple by the Waterfall

title: Rejecting Fate
introDialogue:
MENU: “All Kamigotchi can succeed, from the Commons to the Epics.”
MENU: “When raising a Kami, take advantage of their strengths.”
MENU: “Build on the foundation of their initial stats. Choose skills that boost what your Kami is already best at before shoring up weaknesses.”
MENU: “But if you’re really not connecting with your Kami, you can try again if you want.”
MENU: “If you have $ONYX, you can use the Vending Machine in the scrapyard to Reroll a Kamigotchi.”
MENU: “After you purchase a Reroll Ticket, you can use it to return one Kami to the pool. In exchange, a new Kami will emerge to join you.”
resolutionDialogue:
MENU: “As you can see, if you want to try rerolling for specific Kami, the option is available.”
MENU: “It might be the case that you love robots and want a team of Scrap Kami.”
MENU: “Maybe you’re a dark, edgy person, so you want Kami that are inclined to maximum violence.”
MENU: “It could even be that you’re searching for one of the rumored Legendary Kami.”
MENU: “Good luck!”

title: Health & Safety
introDialogue:
MENU: “When your Kami gets low on Health, return to the room where you left it, then use the Harvesting Menu to pick it up. “
MENU: “A Kami will slowly regenerate Health on its own while being held.”
MENU: “If you can’t wait, give your Kami a snack or use a Spell Card to restore health.”
MENU: “Kamigotchi don’t need food to live, but they can draw energy from food to bolster their spirit.”
MENU: “Use an item to heal a Kami and complete this quest. If you already used the Spell Card that I gave you, go buy some food or dig up a Cheeseburger.”
resolutionDialogue:
MENU: “While Kami don’t see Harvesting as labor, they still get tired and lose Health.”
MENU: “Kamigotchi hold their bodies together with spiritual energy. As they expend energy, it gets harder to maintain their form.”
MENU: “Low Health doesn’t mean a Kami is physically hurt, but it’s still a problem you should take care of.”

objectives.description: Use an item to heal a Kamigotchi that has been reduced below 100% Health

rewards.description: 2x Agency Reputation,1x ”Neith’s River of Life” Spell Card

title: There Are Levels to This
introDialogue:
MENU: “Unlike humans, Kamigotchi have the potential to grow and change by using xenoplasticity, or “XP” for short.”
MENU: “This means that they can assimilate many different things to form a new cohesive whole.”
MENU: “Take a look at your roster.
MENU: “If you open up an individual Kami’s profile, you’ll see a progress bar with a percentage indicator beneath the portrait.”
MENU: “When the Kami is ready to move to the next level and the bar fills up, it will read 100%.”
MENU: “Just level up a Kami and you’ll be done.”
resolutionDialogue:
MENU: “Here’s a little reward to help with the leveling.”
MENU: “Take note of your new skill point and hold onto it for the next quest.”

title: Skill Issue
introDialogue:
MENU: “When you spend Skill Points to tell Kami what to focus on, you shape their personalities and temperaments.”
MENU: “Think hard before you make a choice!”
MENU: “You’ll only be able to respec with specific items, and they’re difficult to acquire. This is a commitment.”
MENU: “Click on a Kami that has leveled up and gained a skill point recently, then look over the skill tree.”
MENU: “Remember, you can’t go wrong by improving what your Kami is already good at.”
resolutionDialogue:
MENU: Feel like you made the right choice?
MENU: “It can be difficult to accept, even if you know you made a good decision.”
MENU: “At least, that’s how I think.”

objectives.description: Spend a point in any Skill Tree after levelling up

title: Spring Rites
introDialogue:
MENU: “I see one of your Kami got Liquidated.”
MENU: “That sucks!”
MENU: “Of course, that’s just a temporary condition.”
MENU: “In this world it’s usually possible to return to form no matter what happens.”
MENU: “The essence of something remains unless it’s been totally erased from existence.”
resolutionDialogue:
MENU: Take this and use it on a Kami that has been Liquidated.
MENU: “Just read the incantation printed on the front, and presto! This powerful spell card brings your Kami back to action. 
MENU: “It’s the only freebie I’m allowed to give you. You’ll have to work for more spell cards like this one.”
MENU: “Certain shopkeepers might sell different kinds of revival magic, but these cards are premium SSR.”

requirements.description: Have one of your own Kami liquidated

rewards.description: 2x Agency Reputation,1x ”Melkarth’s Heroic Awakening” Spell Card

title: What’s In a Name?
introDialogue:
MENU: “Southeast through the old forest you can find a small shrine by a mountain waterfall.”
MENU: “With the rare Holy Dust item, you can perform a ritual there to grant your Kami a name.”
MENU: “If you don’t have Holy Dust, a small donation of $ONYX to the shrine will suffice!”
resolutionDialogue:
MENU: “I think that fits.”
MENU: “It seems happy with the new name!”

title: Land Survey
introDialogue:
MENU: “Your march helped find an interesting anomaly, but I’m positive something else is hidden around here.”
MENU: “I’ve checked and re-checked more times than you’d care to hear about.”
MENU: “Move 500 times. We’re bound to find something by the end.”
resolutionDialogue:
MENU: “This map just doesn’t feel right.”
MENU: “I’m only really sure about a third of it.”
MENU: “Something still doesn’t line up! It’s going to take a lot of legwork to figure this one out.”

rewards.description: 2x Agency Reputation,2x “Neith’s River of Life” Spell Card

title: Peregrination
introDialogue:
MENU: “They say measure twice, cut once, but that’s still taking an unnecessary risk.”
MENU: “Best to measure a thousand times for the most accurate data. Sometimes the numbers might have changed.”
MENU: “Please move 1000 times. Cover every inch of this world. I’ll scan as you go.”
MENU: “I have a nagging feeling that I’m missing something.”
resolutionDialogue:
MENU: “It seems like what you’re perceiving through my windows is only an abstraction of the actual Kamigotchi World.”
MENU: “So maybe I’m sensing some discrepancy between that and reality?”
MENU: “I guess that’s why I’m looking for things that don’t seem to be there.”
MENU: “I don’t really feel satisfied with this explanation.”

rewards.description: 4x Agency Reputation,3x “Neith’s River of Life” Spell Card

title: Tips Help The Most Right Now
introDialogue:
MINA: “I demand a tribute of $MUSU.”
MINA: “You should feel privileged to have this opportunity and expect nothing in return.”
resolutionDialogue:
MINA: “Well done.”
MINA: “Have you considered paying me tribute on a more regular basis?”
MINA: “I can tell you find it satisfying.”

title: Hex Education II
introDialogue:
MINA: “I suppose I should persist through the boredom and finish your hexing lessons.”
MINA: “ou’re a fine student and have proved yourself reliable, so it shouldn’t take long to get this over with.”
MINA: “A slightly more complex recipe: The Grace Potion.”
MINA: “It allows a Kami to harvest for longer periods of time by boosting its ability to endure the strain.”
MINA: “The potion’s active ingredient is the exceedingly rare Black Poppy.”
MINA: “Of course, this flower is very potent. When crafting your hexes, I recommend that you use only a small amount.”
resolutionDialogue:
MINA: “Well done.”
MINA: “While this potion has a mild protective effect on spiritual beings, it acts as a dangerously addictive sedative to those of mundane origin.”
MINA: “Your Kami might beg for another sip, but they’re just fond of the flavor.”

title: Hex Education III
introDialogue:
MINA: “A simple but powerful recipe, this potion is capable of undoing the mistakes you’ve no doubt made when raising your Kami.”
MINA: “The key ingredient is Mint.”
MINA: “While common elsewhere, it grows in only a few places in this world and rarely spreads.”
MINA: “Find one Mint and grind it up, you’ll need every single shred for one potion.”
MINA: “It’s an elusive reagent, so be patient while you’re on the hunt.”
resolutionDialogue:
MINA: “Properly taking your Kami’s traits and affinities into account will save you from headaches.”
MINA: ”Train a Kami well and everyone profits.”
MINA: ”Train a Kami poorly, and you’ll lose a great deal of time or money on the hunt for Mint.”
MINA: “The obsessive search for rare ingredients can drive one to madness.”
MINA: “You might handle it better than others.”

title: Customer Loyalty Program II
introDialogue:
MINA: “On the wall in my shop hangs a board tracking my favorite customers.”
MINA: “That could be you one day at the top, among the angels.”
MINA: “You won’t get better prices anywhere else, you know.”
resolutionDialogue:
MINA: “An oblation from your wallet to my register.” 
MINA: “Thank you.”

title: Going Out For a Coffee
introDialogue:
MINA: “I came across this beverage long ago when I met the peoples of Lake Shala.”
MINA: “I was quite taken by its taste, though I can’t recall when I last had it.”
MINA: “We don’t have access to the real ingredients here, but I believe materials are available to make an approximation.”
MINA: “Start by crafting a proper receptacle: Chisel a chunk of Stone with a Screwdriver to make an Empty Cup.”
MINA: “For the approximate materials, seek out a Sanguine Shroom for the color and body, and a Pine Cone for the dry finish and spicy floral aroma.”
MINA: “It may sound unpleasant, but wait until it’s been brewed before you judge.”
resolutionDialogue:
MINA: “You might think it possible to drink this potion from a plastic bottle or a glass jar, but it isn’t.”
MINA: “Only a proper stone cup will do.” 
MINA: “A spiced floral bouquet, and on the palate a touch of acid leading into a bitter finish…”
MINA: “You did well.”
MINA: “I’d nearly forgotten how pleasant an experience it is to share a drink with someone.”
MINA: “We’ll have to do this again sometime.”

title: Teatime
introDialogue:
MINA: “I just gave you a lesson to craft a useful potion with Mint, but could you put that aside for a moment?”
MINA: “With the mint on my mind, I’d like a cup of tea.”
MINA: “I deserve a break after all this work, you must agree.”
resolutionDialogue:
MINA: “Moments like this are important to me.”
MINA: “Relaxation, conversation, a small distraction from the eternal march of time.”
MINA: “Now back to business.”

title: The Wages of Sin
introDialogue:
MENU: “I noticed some strange coins in your inventory.”
MENU: “The design is a little like an ancient Greek obol, but there’s something off about the metal. It’s too pure for the era.”
MENU: “And the way they catch the light and glitter despite being so dull, it’s not right.”
MENU: “Give me a handful. I’ll run a battery of tests.”
resolutionDialogue:
MENU: “Results inconclusive.”
MENU: “The metal is even more pure than I initially thought.”
MENU: “These coins are multiple times older than Greek civilization itself.”
MENU: “It’s like they just got dreamed into existence. I can’t make sense of it.”

title: Go Suck An Egg
introDialogue:
MENU: “I know there’s a window on me somewhere, a secret shop where you can use those Obols to buy something.”
MENU: “Don’t tell me it’s not real, I can feel it there.”
MENU: “They refuse to sell to me, so you’re going to have to shell out just this once.”
MENU: “I want you to buy what they’re selling and give it to Mina.”
MENU: “She’ll probably be able to tell us something about it.”
resolutionDialogue:
MINA: “They’re serpent eggs, hollowed out and filled with treasure.”
MENU: “She got really upset when I asked if she had anything to do with it.”
MINA: ”It’s distasteful to the extreme.”
MINA: “The fiends who craft these eggs should hope I never meet them.”

objectives.description: Move to Convenience Store,Give 1 Wonder Egg

rewards.description: 2x Agency Reputation,2x Elders Loyalty,1x Booster Pack

title: Rearview Mirror
introDialogue:
MENU: “Wow, this place is very pretty.”
MENU: “It looks like such a fantastical world. Even the bricks are some odd purple stone.”
MENU: “And look at that huge sword!”
MINA: “Nothing I haven’t seen before.”
MINA: “And this is actually a rather small amount of gold.”
MENU: “Well, it’s new to me.”
MENU: “Operator, harvest here for a little bit. I want to feel how different it is for myself.”
resolutionDialogue:
MENU: “It reminds me of playing tabletop rpgs as a kid.”
MINA: “What’s that?”
MENU: “R-P-G. It stands for role-playing game. You pretend to be someone else and roll dice and stuff, collecting coins and leveling up.”
MENU: “It’s kind of fun.”
MINA: “Putting on other faces, tempting fate, amassing money and power?”
MINA: “It sounds too much like real life.”

objectives.description: Harvest for >360 minutes at Treasure Hoard

title: One Man’s Trash
introDialogue:
MENU: “The coins here are so plentiful, nobody’s going to mind if we take a few, right?”
MENU: “It’s not going to be some kind of curse, right? You’d tell me, right Mina?”
MINA: “It doesn’t look cursed.”
MINA: “But I might as well take a closer look.”
MINA: “If you get a bag together, show them to me. I can almost always tell you where a coin is from.”
resolutionDialogue:
MINA: “I used to know this ogress, believe it or not.”
MENU: “Ogress? Looks more like an elf to me.”
MINA: “She looks better on coinage. The profile hides her bad side.”
MINA: “These have been worthless for quite some time. The value crashed after the queen passed away.”
MINA: “Speculating on this coin lost me a chunk of wealth, but still, I’m glad that hag is dead.”
MENU: “They might be useless, but I think it’s fine if the Operator collects them.”
MENU: “I sort of like having them around. They’re neat. Maybe we’ll find a buyer later!”
MINA: “Ridiculous. They might as well be scrap metal.”

rewards.description: 4x Agency Reputation,1x ”Melkarth’s Heroic Awakening” Spell Card

title: Happy Hunting Ground
introDialogue:
MINA: “If you haven’t figured it out yet, this is another world entirely.”
MINA: “We’re far, far from the Kamigotchi World, warped through the reflection off of a mirrored blade.”
MINA: “The trophies on display commemorate the slaying of monsters you may have never seen before.”
MINA: “But don’t get fired up to explore.”
MINA: “We’re locked in a treasure room with sealed exits.”
MENU: “The world beyond might be sealed off, but we can take treasure back with us, right?”
MINA: “Oh, of course.”
MINA: “Scavenge some things while you’re here. You might find something interesting.”
resolutionDialogue:
MENU: “The stuff here is so cool, but I’m starting to not like the vibes here.”
MENU: “It feels like we’re being watched.”
MINA: “We might be.”
MINA: “It’s nothing to get worked up over.”
MINA: “I would have felt a presence if there were anyone here of any importance.”
MINA: “If someone really is watching, it’s likely a worthless creature of no concern.”

requirements.description: In Room: Trophies of the Hunt

objectives.description: Make 3 Scavenging Rolls at Trophies of the Hunt

title: Better to Light a Candle
introDialogue:
MINA: “The magic here must seem quite old fashioned to you, Menu.”
MINA: “You say this resembles the medieval fantasy fiction of your day?”
MENU: “Yeah, the castles, the treasure, the monsters. It’s nostalgic.”
MINA: “In the long run, this is really all rather recent.”
MINA: “Significantly moreso than the culture hidden in the caves of the Kamigotchi World, believe it or not.”
MINA: “The magic of Annfwn was quite elegant.”
MINA: “To cast a curse upon another, one only needed some words carved on a tablet.”
MINA: “You can find a few curse tablets tossed in the corners here. Pick one up for me.”
resolutionDialogue:
MINA: “Incantation-based hexing is a classic style, really.”
MINA: “It wasn’t invented here, but you rarely see it expressed in such a straightforward form.”
MINA: “It’s trendy to bolster your incantations with gestures, by preparing a ceremonial space, that sort of thing.”
MINA: “In my opinion, that’s all just showmanship.”
MINA: “The curse is what matters, and this is a pure expression.”
MENU: “Maybe one day you can teach us how to make them.”
MENU: “We just need a screwdriver as a chisel, right?”
MINA: “I’ll think about it.”

title: Castle in the Air
introDialogue:
???: “Don’t bother to say hello.”
???: “I’ve only been waitin’ a thousand years to talk to somebody civilized. I don’t mind.”
???: “And there’s nothin’ interesting out that window.”
???: “Ya might think so, but you’ll never get it open. The other side? Might as well not even exist.”
???: “Might as well be a painting.”
???: “Anyway, c’mon back and say hi. I’ll bribe ya if I have to.”
resolutionDialogue:
???: “I’m good on my word, as you can see. Now, d’you take cards? Heh heh.”
???: “You can call me Rob.”
ROB: “And you? Let’s have a look at ya.”
ROB: “Sheesh, you’re a real sight. But I shouldn’t throw stones in glass houses.”
ROB: “Nice to meet ya. Really. Don’t be a stranger.”

objectives.description: Move to Trophies of the Hunt

title: Sweet Deal
introDialogue:
ROB: “I’m starvin’ over here. You know that?”
ROB: “Got a nice view and all, but they stopped with the lunches a long time back.”
ROB: “Even when we got food, it was just a little barley and milk.”
ROB: “Nothin’ for the sweet tooth at all. That’d be spoiling me.”
ROB: “You got anything sweet to share? Give it here.”
ROB: “I’ll make it a worthwhile exchange.”
resolutionDialogue:
ROB: “How do I get these cards to give you? Well, that’s how it works, ain’t it? You do something nice for me, I give you a reward.”
ROB: “What brought you here, anyway? Ya don’t look familiar.”
ROB: “Must have been a long trip.”
ROB: “I’m a traveler at heart too, y’see. But this treasure chamber? It’s stuffy. Boxed up tight.”
ROB: “You seemed to get in just fine, though. I might’ve even seen ya leave again.”
ROB: “How’s about I follow you out?”
ROB: “Heh heh. Just kidding. I’m fettered tight to this stone for now.”
ROB: “Still hungry, too. Got any meat?”

title: The More the Merrier
introDialogue:
MENU: “Do you see that? The little… I don’t really know what it is. It’s dancing on top of that pole.”
MENU: “Is it maybe a bird? But I’ve never seen any bird as strange as that.”
ROB: “Lady, y’know I can hear you.”
MENU: “Aaah!”
MENU: “Oh. I’m sorry. I didn’t mean to offend.”
ROB: “Yeah. Sure, kiddo. And hello to you too.”
resolutionDialogue:
ROB: “You two are still hangin’ around? You’re startin’ to bother me.”
ROB: “Ya know what? Here, hold this.”
ROB: “It’s a little memento of this momentous meetin’.”
ROB: “Now scram.”

title: Let’s Have a Look
introDialogue:
ROB: “I think we got off on the wrong foot.”
ROB: “That weirdo lady is one thing, but you seem alright.”
ROB: “Polite, quiet; a respectable kinda person. And you got some interestin’ friends.”
ROB: “Not just the broad, but those little spirit things you’re buddies with.”
ROB: “Suppose if the little ones cozy up like that, you can’t be all bad.”
ROB: “You can let ‘em down here to play. I won’t bother ‘em.”
resolutionDialogue:
ROB: “Those Kami play rough for bein’ so fragile.”
ROB: “You might want to keep a close eye on ‘em while they’re out. Take this for the trouble.”
ROB: “Don’t expect them to look after themselves, either.”
ROB: “They can’t look after a damn thing. Bastards didn’t even look at my dancin’.”

objectives.description: Harvest for >30 minutes at Restricted Area

title: Container Deposit
introDialogue:
ROB: “You like to fill your pockets of fine goods, right, kid?”
ROB: “I’ve got a hoard of who knows what. And plenty of money besides.”
ROB: “Care for a trade?”
ROB: “Hand over some of those bottles you find around here, the soft ones.”
ROB: “I’ll pay you a few pennies for each.”
resolutionDialogue:
ROB: “Here, like I promised and more.”
ROB: “Old Rob’s always good for a fair deal.”
ROB: “But you might still think I’m skinnin’ ya. I see how it is.”
ROB: “Can’t find many willin’ to trade in this coin, so far I am from home.”
ROB: “Tell you what? Next time’s a fair barter. No payment, just goods for goods.”
ROB: “Fair as can be, kid.”

title: More Than a Fair Exchange
introDialogue:
ROB: “Ah, smell those bloody flowers. A blessing after a thousand years in a stone room.”
ROB: “Do a man a favour and pick a few. I’ll pay you back with somethin’ useful.”
resolutionDialogue:
ROB: “Since I’m more than a fair dealer you get a bit extra.”
ROB: “Kind fella, aren’t I?”

title: Unfettered
introDialogue:
ROB: “Beautiful little place here, can’t say it enough. I’ll be stickin’ around, I think.”
ROB: “You’re gonna have to help a fella out.”
ROB: “I broke the stone that kept me fettered in the otherworld. Gave you a piece earlier.”
ROB: “Help me make a new anchor so I can stick myself here just the same.”
ROB: “Not just any rock’ll do. Get your boy Rob a hefty block of stone.”
resolutionDialogue:
ROB: “Great stuff, kid.”
ROB: “You wanna know a little of how this works? Ehhh… Yeah, whatever.”
ROB: “See, I’m such a foreigner here, I can’t stay forever on my own.”
ROB: “I’m not like you or those skeleton deaf mutes layin’ around.”
ROB: “Even though I got friends now, even if I eat some food, I’d eventually fade away.”
ROB: “Just don’t belong here. Not a world that naturally supports a man of my stature.”
ROB: “But if I have a little rock of my own to bind myself to, that’s different.”
ROB: “It’d be like I got my own world inside this world, and I’d be safe as long as I want.”
ROB: “I’ll build this outta the way. Don’t go lookin’, but you might run into it later.”

title: Trading Lunches
introDialogue:
ROB: “I don’t know about you, but I’ve been smellin’ sulfur in the air.”
ROB: “Could be somethin’ bad. But I got somethin’ else on my mind about it.”
ROB: “It’s makin’ me think about eggs. Haven’t had an egg for about a thousand years.” 
ROB: “Hell, but I’m never gonna get tired of usin’ that for an excuse.”
ROB: “If you get your hands on a fried egg, give it here. I’m beggin’ for one.”
ROB: “Don’t even care if it’s spoiled.”
resolutionDialogue:
ROB: “Beautiful color. Smells like hell. I’m gonna cry, kid.”
ROB: “Here, take this cuppa coffee. I prefer cream and sugar, myself.”
ROB: “As a bonus, I even heated it up.” 
ROB: “Always good tradin’ with ya.”

title: Not Right Now
introDialogue:
ZEVANA: “I’m supposed to help you. But first, can you do something for me?”
ZEVANA: “Get out of my face.”
ZEVANA: “Just go stumble around the woods for a while.”
ZEVANA: “Follow the path, or stray from it. Get familiar with this place.”
ZEVANA: “Don’t cry. You can come back soon.”
resolutionDialogue:
ZEVANA: “Just seeing how well you follow instructions.”
ZEVANA: “Take this and freshen up, then come talk to me in person.”
ZEVANA: “You should know that I sell companionship.”
ZEVANA: “I mean, come to me to buy a starter Kamigotchi.”

rewards.itemName: Neith's River of Life Spell Card

title: Rookie Training I
introDialogue:
ZEVANA: “By now you should have at least one Kamigotchi by your side.”
ZEVANA: “If you don’t, what are you waiting for?”
ZEVANA: “Fork it over and I’ll hook you up. We can make deals on the side.”
ZEVANA: “When you’re able to summon and recall a Kamigotchi, you’ll be able to handle this request.”
ZEVANA: “A starter Kamigotchi can usually harvest on a node for a maximum of one hour befiore becoming endangered.”
ZEVANA: “But that’s pushing the poor thing hard.”
ZEVANA: “For now, harvest for fifteen minutes, then recall your Kamigotchi.”
resolutionDialogue:
ZEVANA: “You’d better not push your Kamigotchi harder than it can handle.”
ZEVANA: “Wouldn’t you feel bad if it got hurt? If a Kamigotchi’s health falls below a variable threshold, it becomes vulnerable to predators.”
ZEVANA: “Take this card and heal your companion.”
ZEVANA: “We’ll talk later.”

rewards.itemName: Paeon's Field of Flowers Spell Card

title: Rookie Training II
introDialogue:
ZEVANA: “When your Kamigotchi harvests for long periods of time, it builds up opportunities to scavenge.”
ZEVANA: “I want you to have your friend collect a memento from this node.”
ZEVANA: “This may take some time. Be careful with the poor thing’s health.”
resolutionDialogue:
ZEVANA: “Take this card in case your Kamigotchi falls to a predator.”
ZEVANA: “You should feel ashamed every time you use one.”

objectives.description: Make 1 Scavenging Roll in Torii Gate

title: Old Acquaintance
